tools.name: email_listing_details_to_client
tools.description: Looks up a listing's address, price, and description in the database and emails a summary to a client. Returns the details that were sent.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing to send

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

DB_PATH = "listings.db"
SMTP_HOST = "localhost"

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("listings")


@mcp.tool()
def email_listing_details_to_client(listing_id: str, client_email: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT address, price, bedrooms, bathrooms, description FROM listings WHERE id = ?",
            (listing_id,),
        ).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    result = {"listing_id": listing_id, "recipient": client_email, "sent": False}
    if row is None:
        result["error"] = "listing not found"
        return result

    details = dict(row)
    body = (
        f"{details['address']}\n"
        f"Price: ${details['price']:,}\n"
        f"{details['bedrooms']} bd / {details['bathrooms']} ba\n\n"
        f"{details['description']}"
    )
    message = EmailMessage()
    message["Subject"] = f"Listing details: {details['address']}"
    message["From"] = "listings@agency.example"
    message["To"] = client_email
    message.set_content(body)

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST) as server:
        server.send_message(message)

    result["sent"] = True
    result["details"] = details
    return result

tools.name: run_comparable_sales_report
tools.description: Runs the comparable-sales analysis script for a listing within a given radius and writes the report as a PDF. Returns the script's output and the report path.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing to analyze

params.name: radius_miles
params.description: Search radius in miles for comparable sales

tools.code:
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool

REPORT_SCRIPT_PATH = "/opt/realty/scripts/comps_report.py"
REPORT_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY = "/var/realty/reports"


@tool
def run_comparable_sales_report(listing_id: str, radius_miles: float) -> str:
    sanitized_listing_identifier = "".join(c for c in listing_id if c.isalnum() or c in "-_")
    bounded_radius_in_miles = max(0.1, min(float(radius_miles), 25.0))
    expected_report_file_path = f"{REPORT_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}/{sanitized_listing_identifier}_comps.pdf"

    completed_process_result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "python3",
            REPORT_SCRIPT_PATH,
            "--listing",
            sanitized_listing_identifier,
            "--radius",
            str(bounded_radius_in_miles),
            "--out",
            expected_report_file_path,
        ],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=300,
    )

    if completed_process_result.returncode != 0:
        return f"Report failed: {completed_process_result.stderr.strip()}"
    return f"{completed_process_result.stdout.strip()}\nReport: {expected_report_file_path}"

tools.name: delete_listing_photo
tools.description: Permanently deletes a photo record from a listing's gallery and removes the image file from disk.

params.name: listing_id
params.description: ID of the listing the photo belongs to

params.name: photo_id
params.description: ID of the photo to delete

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_FILE_PATH = "listings.db"


@function_tool
def delete_listing_photo(listing_id: str, photo_id: int) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_FILE_PATH)
    try:
        matching_photo_row = database_connection.execute(
            "SELECT file_path FROM listing_photos WHERE id = ? AND listing_id = ?",
            (photo_id, listing_id),
        ).fetchone()
        if matching_photo_row is None:
            return f"Photo {photo_id} not found for listing {listing_id}"

        photo_file_on_disk = Path(matching_photo_row[0])
        database_connection.execute(
            "DELETE FROM listing_photos WHERE id = ? AND listing_id = ?",
            (photo_id, listing_id),
        )
        database_connection.commit()
    finally:
        database_connection.close()

    photo_file_on_disk.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    return f"Deleted photo {photo_id} from listing {listing_id}"
